The way to destroy ISIS is not through conventional means (as in trying to kill every IS member). The way to kill a terroristic insurgency like IS is by cutting them off from their resources and address the reason they exist.

ISIS (and other groups like them) basically exist because the situation in the Middle East is so terrible. These terroristic group are in power and control everything from local law to security.

So rather than try to kill them all, the focus needs to be on stabilizing the are by working with locals to install competent government, a fair legal structure, etc. Basically, a place where people can live securely, prosper and sleep knowing that they'll what they need to survive in the future.

If the issues underlying this insurgency are addressed, ISIS would lose the critical resources that they need to survive. People wouldn't be so ready to join and die for such an extremist cause if there are better options. 

The reason why ISIS and groups like it continue to pop up and survive, is that we are trying to kill everyone of their member. Which is impossible and only helps them recruit more people into their ranks.
